name: cascade-coding-agent
description: Audits, adapts, integrates, and evolves Codex and coding-agent harnesses while preserving target-repository authority.

interface.longDescription: Audit, adapt, and safely evolve AGENTS.md, Codex routing, skills, roles, configuration, hooks, tools, memory, observability, evaluation wiring, and validation surfaces. This plugin engineers coding-agent systems; Cascade Evals owns harness evaluation, and this plugin does not grant execution authority or replace target runners and persistence.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's Codex and agent harness for defects and duplicate authority.
Adapt this coding-agent harness to a target repository.
Maintain this harness or integrate a reviewed agent architecture packet with the smallest validated change.
